summary: Viatris Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 8.01, 9.01) reporting its first-quarter 2026 financial results as of March 31, 2026. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 shows total revenues of $3.5 billion (8% reported growth vs Q1 2025) and U.S. GAAP net earnings of $176 million. Adjusted EBITDA was $1.0 billion. No special-situation deal terms, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews are mentioned. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings release and conference call notice. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring event. No deal terms exist. What to watch: continued operational performance and cash deployment guidance.
